profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: My name is Jonathan Kim and I formerly work for General Motors as a Software Developer. Graduate at University of Washington Tacoma with a Bachelor’s of Science in Computer Science.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
•Maintained constant presence on sales floor to address customer needs
•Managed inventory, sales, returns, and exchange.
•Prepared and maintained inventory in order to restock
•Cultivated strong business relationships with customers to increase business sales.

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description:
•Assist customers over the phone with questions about products
•Helped with sale, return, and exchange products
•Answer questions and set up reservations pertaining to in-store repairs
•Demonstrate company sales model in order to offer each customer the complete solution to their purchase.
